title: Midterm prep: Calvin cycle and C4/CAM

utterances.text: Let's go through photosynthesis for the midterm. Sam, you take notes.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 1

utterances.text: Fine. So light reactions are in the thylakoids. Water gets split, that's photolysis, two H2O gives four H plus, four electrons and one O2.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 2

utterances.text: The oxygen we breathe comes from the water, not from the CO2. That's a classic trick question.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 1

utterances.text: Did you guys see the game last night? Unreal.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 3

utterances.text: Focus. Calvin cycle has three phases: carbon fixation, reduction, and regeneration of RuBP.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 2

utterances.text: RuBisCO is the enzyme for fixation, it's the most abundant protein on Earth.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 1

utterances.text: The product isn't glucose directly. It's G3P, glyceraldehyde three phosphate. Glucose is made from G3P later.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 3

utterances.text: For every three CO2 fixed you spend nine ATP and six NADPH, and you get one net G3P.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 2

utterances.text: Also C4 and CAM plants. C4 plants like corn separate carbon fixation spatially using PEP carboxylase to avoid photorespiration.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 1

utterances.text: CAM plants like cacti separate it in time, they open stomata at night.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 3

utterances.text: Photorespiration happens because RuBisCO can grab oxygen instead of CO2, especially when it's hot.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 2

utterances.text: Okay my mom's calling, I'll be right back.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 1

utterances.text: Oh and chlorophyll is green because it absorbs green light the most, so green light is the best for photosynthesis.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 3

utterances.text: For chemiosmosis I think of a dam. The protons pile up behind the membrane like water, and ATP synthase is the turbine they flow through to make ATP.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 1

utterances.text: We should really focus on photorespiration for the midterm, she said it's going to be on there.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 2

utterances.text: And everyone do the chapter 8 practice problems before Thursday.
utterances.speaker: Speaker 3
